fields.options: Upload a spreadsheet with columns ID, azzir_alias_codes.code, azzir_alias_codes.is_primary, azzir_alias_codes.source. Use Dry Run first to preview, then Run Import to apply (runs in the background). For each item its code table is replaced; the item's own code stays Primary so nothing is renamed.

fields.label: Sheet / Tab Name
fields.description: Worksheet name in the file (defaults to the first sheet if not found).

fields.label: Mode
fields.description: Replace: match items by ID (exact code). Reconcile: match by ANY code and rename the item to its Primary code (fixes items that were manually renamed).

fields.label: Not-Updated Report (CSV)
fields.description: Download to see every item/code that was skipped (missing or conflict).
